about: The mutant ledger of internal/rpcgen's tests, started by Rm (wf10, 2026-11-10): edits of std rpc and its runtime/v1 bodies that only a built rpc server observes. Each mutant names the rule it breaks and the test that kills it; pkg is the package of the killer.

mutants.name: rpc-answer-buffers
mutants.rule: An ndjson batch is answered as a stream of Exit lines, not as one buffered answer (rpc.md rule 2).

mutants.name: rpc-lines-at-end
mutants.rule: Each Exit line of an ndjson batch is emitted as its call ends, while other calls of the batch are still held.

mutants.name: rpc-mount-exact
mutants.origin: wf10 Rm (R1 rpc-m4, moved into Answer)
mutants.rule: Answer answers the mount with a trailing slash, where Effect's RpcClient (and Call) posts.

mutants.name: rchk-wide-die-defect
mutants.rule: A Die named Unrepresentable (an int the server would not send) is the typed rpc.Unrepresentable for a client (rpc.md, Call and the int rule).

mutants.name: rchk-wide-die-path
mutants.rule: The Die of a refused int carries its path, so the client's Unrepresentable names where the int is.

mutants.name: rchk-lost-defect
mutants.rule: A lost or refused connection and a status other than 200 are rpc.Transport, a typed failure of Call.

mutants.name: rchk-unnamed-defect
mutants.rule: In the checked call, a failure the row does not name is rpc.Transport, not a defect.

mutants.name: rchk-bad-value-defect
mutants.from: return Transport{Reason: "the \(what) is not the contract's: \(text)"}
mutants.rule: A value or failure that is not the contract's fails rpc.Transport in rpc.Decode, so the checked call names it.

mutants.name: rchk-row-no-wide
mutants.rule: The checked row of an operation that carries an int names rpc.Unrepresentable.

mutants.name: rchk-provider-wide-lost
mutants.from: fmt.Fprintf(&b, "case rpc.Unrepresentable as u:\n%srpc.Refuse[%s](u)\n", ret, res)
mutants.to: fmt.Fprintf(&b, "case rpc.Unrepresentable as u:\n%srpc.Lost[%s](rpc.Transport{Reason: u.Path})\n", ret, res)
mutants.rule: The provider raises a refused int as the Unrepresentable defect (rpc.Refuse), as R1 did.
